circularity_statement: Consistency checks C1–C5 were pre-registered before any predictions were computed on the observed data. Predictions and observed values were generated and compared independently. The observed dataset (Rodrigues et al. 2025, R1) was used only inside engine/src/pharmashed/checks/ (separation enforced by tests/test_separation.py). Checks with illustrative inputs are labelled 'illustrative inputs — not evidence' (D35).
